title: GUI option for reverting klipperClearHistoryAskAgain option is missing
line: After choosing "Do not ask again" when clearing the clipboard history, the question can be turned back on in the clipboard settings.
explanation: The Clear History confirmation was a KMessageBox with "Do not ask again", which stored its answer as klipperClearHistoryAskAgain in plasmashellrc. Nothing in the clipboard settings read or wrote that key, so once ticked the only way back was editing the file by hand. Tomáš Hnyk's MR !7125 moves the question inline into the clipboard pop-up, stores the choice as ConfirmClearHistory in klipperrc with an "Ask before clearing clipboard history" checkbox in the General settings page, migrates the old plasmashellrc key, and replaces the starred-item delete dialog with an undo offer.

commits.message:
Klipper: Replace modal dialogs with inline dialogs and add undo action

Clearing the history asked in a dialog whose "Do not ask again" could
only be undone in plasmashellrc. The question is now inline, a setting
turns it back on, and removing or editing an entry offers an undo.

BUG: 500896

media.caption: Master: Clear History asks in a separate dialog; ticking "Do not ask again" is permanent
With the MR: the question is inline in the clipboard pop-up, shown again after re-enabling it in the settings
Master: the clipboard settings have no way to bring the question back
With the MR: "Ask before clearing clipboard history" in General; it was unchecked by the migrated plasmashellrc answer
